# laravelforge_server_log (Data Source)

Fetches the content of a single Laravel Forge server log by key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key identifying the server log to fetch.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization that owns the server.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the log belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Content of the server log.
- `id` (String) Resource-level identifier of the server log.
